name: 少输出最后一行
code:
import json,sys
n=int(sys.stdin.read().strip()); rows=[]
for i in range(max(0,n-1)):
 r=[1]*(i+1)
 for j in range(1,i):r[j]=rows[i-1][j-1]+rows[i-1][j]
 rows.append(r)
print(json.dumps(rows,separators=(",",":")))

name: 错误累加左侧系数
code:
import json,sys
n=int(sys.stdin.read().strip()); rows=[]
for i in range(n):
 r=[1]*(i+1)
 for j in range(1,i):r[j]=2*rows[i-1][j-1]
 rows.append(r)
print(json.dumps(rows,separators=(",",":")))
